events.verdict: Markkanen (UTA) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Markkanen (UTA) begins to lose control of the ball prior to Simmons (LAC) reaching in. The ensuing contact with Markkanen's lower body is marginal.
Batum (LAC) briefly has an arm around Markkanen (UTA), but allows him to move freely. When Markkanen comes together with Powell (LAC) at the same spot, the contact is marginal.
Dunn (LAC) moves laterally into Collier (UTA) and initiates illegal contact that affects his driving shot attempt.
Collins (UTA) lands in front of Harden (LAC), who extends his legs and creates any marginal contact that occurs during his jump shot attempt.
Bogdanovic (LAC) reaches in and makes clean contact with the ball to deflect it away rom Collins (UTA).
Batum (LAC) legally contests George's (UTA) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Mykhailiuk (UTA) gathers the ball and legally takes two steps into his upward shooting motion.
Bogdanovic (LAC) maintains a legal guarding position during Collins' (UTA) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Batum (LAC) legally contests Collins' (UTA) jump shot attempt.
Harden (LAC) reaches in and makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge it from Markkanen's (UTA) possession.
Collier (UTA) establishes himself in a legal guarding position in Harden's (LAC) path and Harden dislodges him from his position.
Powell (LAC) legally contests Markkanen's (UTA) jump shot attempt.
Simmons (LAC) makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge it from George's (UTA) possession. Any contact with George's hand on the ball is considered incidental.
Simmons (LAC) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Batum (LAC) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Dunn (LAC) legally contests Markkanen's (UTA) shot attempt in the post.
Collins (UTA) commits a take foul on Bogdanovic (LAC).

Collier (UTA) grabs and pulls Powell (LAC), affecting his ability to receive the pass. After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that the foul occurred after the throw-in was released.
Powell (LAC) legally contests George's (UTA) jump shot attempt.
